summary: EFCAR, LLC, as depositor for Exeter Select Automobile Receivables Trust 2026-2, filed a routine 8-K reporting retention of Morgan, Lewis & Bockius LLP and Richards, Layton & Finger, P.A. in connection with its Form SF-3 shelf registration. The filing attaches legality, authorization, enforceability and tax opinions plus consents for a contemplated auto-loan ABS issuance, including Class A-1 notes at 4.311%, Class A-2 at 4.82% and Class A-3 at 5.26%, totaling roughly $324.5 million. No board recommendation, premium, close date or special-situation action is stated; this is ordinary shelf takedown mechanics, not an event-driven special situation.
